# Final Rankings: Most Reliable Under Pressure, Players RR Can Sign (auto-generated)

> **Status: FINAL (information cut-off 14 Nov 2026).** Generated by `src/reporting/rankings_doc.py` from `reports/top_10_batsmen.csv`, `reports/top_10_bowlers.csv` and `reports/model_outputs/reliability_{batting,bowling}.csv`.
> Supersedes `RANKINGS_PROVISIONAL.md`, which ranked all eligible players regardless of contract status.

## Selection rule

The submitted lists contain only players Rajasthan Royals can acquire at the IPL 2027 auction (`src/scouting/final_selection.py`):

- **Not on any IPL 2026 squad** (all 10 teams, RR included), from the data-pack squad mapping.
- **Not Pakistani:** no Pakistan player has appeared in the IPL since 2009 (source S13).
- **Not Bangladeshi:** availability is not reliable after the BCCI-directed release of Mustafizur Rahman (S12). This is a judgement, because no formal rule was published.
- **Not retired or banned from the IPL:** Andre Russell (S7), Ravichandran Ashwin (S15), Mohit Sharma (S16); Harry Brook, because it is unclear whether his ban covers 2027 (S14).

Eligibility thresholds, scoring and weights are unchanged. **Score** is the percentile composite among *all* eligible players, so it compares directly with contracted players. **#**, P(top 10), the bootstrap interval and the range across pressure definitions are recomputed **within the acquirable pool** from the saved bootstrap and definition-variant ranks. **Overall #** is the rank among all eligible players.

## Caveats

- The acquirable pool is clearly weaker than the contracted elite, and every player in it is overseas (RR can hold at most 8 overseas players).
- Several players have little or no IPL record in the data. Their ratings rest on opponent-adjusted T20Is (see the IPL-share column).
- The data pack has no Indian domestic cricket. Uncapped Indian freshers are rated separately from public Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy data: see `reports/top_5_uncapped_batters.csv` and `reports/top_5_uncapped_bowlers.csv`.
- Bowlers #9 and #10 are statistically indistinguishable from the next two (see `near_misses.csv`).
- Players released at the 17 Nov 2026 retention deadline join the pool. Re-run `python -m src.scouting.final_selection` and the reporting steps after it.
